fusions.name: Glassed at Range
fusions.desc: A shot that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 7 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reckoning Glance
fusions.desc: A bolt that deals 14 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, with 60% more damage for each.

fusions.name: Held by the Stare
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Out of Sight
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you deal 5% more damage per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
